svg.text: JOLLY HELMET: THE WHOLE SYSTEM IN ONE CONNECTED CHART
Read it from top to bottom: 1 set-up, 2 a customer visit at Box 1, 2 or 3, 3 the data travels through the LocalServer, Online Server, Blynk and the web page to the owner and the customer

g.text: ESP-NOW RADIO: the new setting goes to the chosen box
ESP-NOW RADIO: coins, status and the finished visit of every box
